reports.title: Humana Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results;

lines: •Raises FY 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance to now be 'at least $9.50', up from the previous expectation of 'at least $9.00'; while revising GAAP EPS guidance to 'at least $15.09', up from the previous estimate of 'at least $6.52'

Humana revises its GAAP EPS guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026 (FY 2026) to 'at least $15.09' from 'at least $6.52', while raising its Adjusted EPS guidance to 'at least $9.50' from the previous guidance of 'at least $9.00'.

•Raises FY 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance to now be 'at least $9.50', up from the previous expectation of 'at least $9.00'; while revising GAAP EPS guidance to 'at least $15.09', up from the previous estimate of 'at least $6.52'

Humana revises its GAAP EPS guidance for the year ending December 31, 2026 (FY 2026) to 'at least $15.09' from 'at least $6.52', while raising its Adjusted EPS guidance to 'at least $9.50' from the previous guidance of 'at least $9.00'.
•Delivered solid results in the third quarter (3Q26) and raised our full year (FY) 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance from ‘at least $9.00’ to ‘at least $9.50’

•Continue to expect that our approach to 2027 individual Medicare Advantage (MA) bids will drive meaningful progress against our commitment of returning to a sustainable pre-tax margin of at least 3% in 2028
